# OSGi Repackaged Bundles

> Repackages third-party Java libraries as OSGi-compliant bundles for deployment in Apache Karaf within the JUDO NG ecosystem.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 (via Maven Wrapper)
- 78 bundle modules — pure POM-based repackaging, no application source code
- Uses Apache Felix `maven-bundle-plugin` 5.1.8 for OSGi manifest generation
- Targets OSGi R7 runtime on Apache Karaf
- Published to both Judo NG Nexus and Maven Central
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module listing, and coding conventions
- [README.md](README.md): Project title

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build-release.yml](.github/workflows/build-release.yml): Manual release workflow (dispatched per-module)
- [.github/workflows/jira-description-to-pr.yml](.github/workflows/jira-description-to-pr.yml): Auto-populates PR body from JIRA ticket
- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Root reactor POM listing all modules
